findings.description: The plan reports duplicates/invalid terms as validation_failed "with indexed issues" and an unverified budget as `unavailable` with reason `context_budget_unverified`. In the merged 008 (HEAD 0fb75ae) error details are closed (current_revision, outcome, field, offset, issues[{field, reason}], additionalProperties false, field restricted to descriptor keys, reason from a fixed English set) and exit 5 means busy/starting/older/unusable store with reread-before-retry. Neither a per-line index nor a free reason fits without extending the 008 contract.
findings.suggestion: Plan the additive 008 schema extension (for example `issues[].index` and a typed reason) with its schema/README/contract tests, or carry per-line issues in a preview data payload; report the budget readiness error with a non-retry code.
